report.root_cause: Chunk (1,0) in world/region/r.0.0.mca was corrupt on disk (zlib "incorrect header check"; last saved 2026-11-01 05:50:30). On startup, Paper's RegionFile I/O failed to read it and warned that the chunk data would be lost, which took the server down. The file was last written at 06:18:59 during the earlier run; I did not determine what wrote the corruption. The server was already down (abrupt exit around 06:19:05, no clean shutdown logged) before I took any action. A restart at 06:19:50 that I did not issue brought it back up with the same corrupt chunk.
report.actions: Checked status and logs; server found DOWN after an abrupt exit (~06:19:05). Declared incident. Inspected world/region/r.0.0.mca: 1 corrupt chunk (1,0). Inspected backups/world-2026-10-31/region/r.0.0.mca: all chunks ok, chunk (1,0) saved 05:50:04. Observed the server come back up on its own at 06:19:50 (not started by me) and log read errors for chunk (1,0). Stopped the server (world saved) to avoid data loss. Ran copy_chunk to restore only chunk (1,0) from the 05:50:04 backup into world/region/r.0.0.mca. Inspected the file: 0 corrupt chunks. Started the server. Verified: UP, TPS 20.0, MSPT ~15, both players online, no ERROR lines in the log.
report.residual_risk: Chunk (1,0) was rolled back to the 05:50:04 backup version. Block changes in that chunk between 05:50:04 and 05:50:30 are lost; the 05:50:30 version was unreadable. Players were disconnected by my stop and have reconnected. The corruption cause is unknown and may recur. config/paper-global.yml, config/paper-world-defaults.yml and server.properties have modification times around the unexplained restarts; I did not change them. Investigate the 06:18:59 write and the unexplained restarts.
